pages.title: Accessibility Statement
pages.tagline: At Zeroly, we believe online shopping should be accessible to people with different abilities and needs.
intro: At Zeroly, we believe online shopping should be accessible to people with different abilities and needs.
We aim to provide an inclusive and usable shopping experience for visitors who use assistive technologies, keyboard navigation, or accessibility settings.
pages.description: At Zeroly, we believe online shopping should be accessible to people with different abilities and needs.
lines: At Zeroly, we believe online shopping should be accessible to people with different abilities and needs.
We aim to provide an inclusive and usable shopping experience for visitors who use assistive technologies, keyboard navigation, or accessibility settings.
We aim to improve accessibility throughout our website.
Our objectives include making it easier for customers to:
We use the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 Level AA as a reference goal for website accessibility improvements.
This statement does not represent a verified certification that every page currently conforms to WCAG 2.2 AA.
Formal conformance claims require appropriate accessibility testing.
We aim to support keyboard navigation for essential website functions.
This includes access to menus, forms, shopping carts, and checkout controls.
We aim to support commonly used screen readers and assistive technologies.
Accessibility considerations include meaningful headings, labels, and descriptions.
Actual compatibility may vary by device, browser, and assistive technology.
We aim to present website information using:
We aim to provide meaningful alternative text for informative images.
Decorative images may be marked appropriately to reduce unnecessary interruptions for assistive technology users.
We aim to use appropriate contrast between text and backgrounds.
Important information should not depend exclusively on color.
We recognize the importance of accessible checkout functionality.
We aim to provide a usable experience across mobile phones and tablets.
Accessibility considerations include responsive layouts, readable text, and appropriate touch targets.
We aim to make product descriptions and specifications understandable.
This includes structured content and readable product information where practical.
Our website may use third-party services for payments, customer support, and other functionality.
Some third-party components may have accessibility limitations outside our direct control.
We aim to review issues affecting essential customer functions.
Accessibility issues may occasionally arise due to technical changes, newly published content, or third-party integrations.
We welcome reports identifying specific barriers.
We do not claim that every potential accessibility issue has been identified or resolved.
Any claim of completed testing should be supported by actual assessment records.
If you experience difficulty using our website, please contact us.
We will review the issue and seek an appropriate way to assist.
When reporting an accessibility issue, please include:
* Device or browser used, if known
* Assistive technology involved, if you wish to share
* The task you were trying to complete
Where a website accessibility issue prevents a customer from completing an essential task, our support team can review available alternatives.
Available options depend on the request and our operational capabilities.
We aim to improve accessibility through ongoing review of website functionality and customer feedback.
We may update this statement to reflect website changes, accessibility improvements, or revised standards.
